Client Requirements
1. Get a Car License Photo
Feature Description: Enable users to upload or capture a photo of a car license using their mobile device.
Functionalities:
Integration with the device’s camera for capturing images.
Option to upload existing photos from the device gallery.
Automatic cropping and optimization of the license photo.
Validation to ensure the uploaded photo meets predefined quality and format standards.
2. Get a Person’s Photo
Feature Description: Allow users to upload or capture their personal photo through the mobile app.
Functionalities:
Integration with the device’s camera for capturing personal photos.
Option to upload existing photos from the device gallery.
Guidelines for taking a clear photo (e.g., proper lighting, face centered).
Validation checks to ensure photo clarity and compliance with required dimensions.
3. Create a Purchase for an Existing Customer
Feature Description: Facilitate the creation of purchase orders for customers already registered in the system.
Functionalities:
Search functionality to locate existing customers using name, ID, or contact information.
Display of customer details upon selection to confirm identity.
Option to select products or services for the purchase.
Automated calculation of the total purchase amount, including applicable taxes and discounts.
4. Create New Customers and Then Create Purchase Orders
Feature Description: Support the registration of new customers and subsequent creation of purchase orders.
Functionalities:
New customer registration form with fields such as name, contact details, address, and other relevant information.
Validation checks to ensure all required fields are completed accurately.
Option to immediately proceed with creating a purchase order after registration.
Seamless integration with the existing customer database.
5. Full Purchase Order Functionality
Feature Description: Provide comprehensive functionality for managing purchase orders through the mobile application.
Functionalities:
Intuitive UI for selecting products/services, specifying quantities, and applying discounts.
Real-time inventory checks to ensure product availability.
Payment gateway integration for processing payments.
Option to save or email purchase order receipts.
View, edit, and cancel existing purchase orders.

Platform: Android and iOS compatibility.
Backend:
Cloud-based server for storing and processing data.
Database integration for customer and order management.
Security:
Data encryption for secure storage and transmission.
Compliance with relevant data protection laws.
Performance:
Optimized for fast loading times and smooth user experience.
Offline mode for creating orders and uploading photos with sync capability once online.
User Roles and Permissions
Admin: Full access to all functionalities, including user management and reporting.
Customer: Restricted access to view and manage their own orders.
Testing and Quality Assurance
Comprehensive testing to ensure:
Compatibility across different devices and operating systems.
Functionality aligns with client requirements.
Photo upload and validation processes work seamlessly.
